summary: Written by: Josh Murchie, John Wolfram, Joseph Spero, Peter Ukhanov, Fernando Tomlinson, Jr., Wesley Shields Introduction Over the past year, Mandiant has responded to a series of linked intrusions demonstrating how Russian cyber espionage group COLD RELIC (formerly tracked as COLDRIVER and UNC4057; also known as Star Blizzard, Callisto, and Gossamer Bear) turns a single cloud compromise into a springboard for ongoing third party compromise and espionage. Most recently, Mandiant investigated a 2026 compromise at a US-based organization where COLD RELIC directly weaponized data, the corporate staff directory, and identities stolen during a late-2025 compromise, which Mandiant also investigated, at a separate US-based organization. COLD RELIC is a Russian state-sponsored threat group that the US Department of Justice (DOJ) has assessed operates within Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB). The group is known for implementing sophisticated phishing and malware campaigns with the aim to gain access to information of strategic or political relevance to the Russian government, as well as to leverage compromised access to target compromised individuals’ broader social and professional networks. Once COLD RELIC compromises a target, it uses stolen emails and data to establish authentic pretexts and impersonate contacts when reaching out to subsequent targets.
